name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a gold explorer focused on a portfolio of projects in Nevada, one of the world's top-rated mining jurisdictions. Its flagship Lapon Canyon Gold Project sits within the prolific Walker Lane gold trend, approximately 40 miles southeast of Yerington, Nevada. The company is in the exploration stage, actively drilling at Lapon Canyon with a goal of defining an NI 43-101 compliant resource.
